Senses.PreferredTarget: surpass buddhas and go beyond patriarchs
Senses.Note: The phrase names a demanded kind of utterance or an asserted capacity, but the stored cases repeatedly answer, test, or criticize that demand rather than defining a rank someone possesses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師再將拄杖示之云超佛越祖之談是你問麼無語
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (C/C077/C077n1710.xml). Recorded Sayings of Ancient Venerable Masters. Muzhou Daoming repeats his staff display and asks whether this was the surpassing talk the monk requested.

Occurrences.Kwic: 時，有僧問：「如何是超佛越祖之談？」師云：「餬餅。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J24/J24nB138.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunmen Kuangzhen. An unnamed monk asks Yunmen Wenyan for surpassing talk, and Yunmen answers with a griddle cake.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 僧問 assigns the exact headword-bearing question to the unnamed monk; 師云 separately introduces Yunmen Wenyan’s cake answer.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex Iriya Lane A focused actor reread

Occurrences.Kwic: 禪不在參，道不須悟，直下了然，超佛越祖。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J10/J10nA158.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun. Miyun Yuanwu asserts the phrase, then immediately asks whether anyone present can enact it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我等學些知解聰明，即謂超佛越祖，豈不自欺？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB163.xml). Selected Record of Chan Master Guting’s Sayings. Guting Shanjian asks whether claiming to surpass buddhas and patriarchs from learned cleverness is not self-deception.

Occurrences.Kwic: 今人動輟欲學超佛越祖之談，絕不學了生死性命之行，真是自暴自棄為背馳之人，深可哀也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB174.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Juelangsheng of Tianjie. Juelang Daosheng condemns seeking surpassing talk while refusing to learn the conduct of settling life and death.

Occurrences.Kwic: 山野雖未向座下吐超佛越祖之談，畢竟沿途瓦礫荊棘也放不過。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB177.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan. Poshan Haiming says in a letter that he has not offered surpassing talk, yet will not let roadside rubble and thorns pass.

Occurrences.Kwic: 任是超佛越祖，頂門更與一錐。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin. Feiyin Tongrong says that even one who surpasses buddhas and patriarchs receives another awl at the crown.

Senses.Explanation: To surpass buddhas and go beyond patriarchs is an elevated claim repeatedly put under public pressure: masters answer its demand with an object, turn it into a challenge, criticize it as cleverness without conduct, or subject even its successful claimant to another test. Muzhou Daoming turns the request into a staff-naming test; Yunmen Wenyan's cake answer refuses the requested register; Miyun Yuanwu states the phrase only to challenge anyone present to meet it. Guting Shanjian calls a clever claim self-deception, Juelang Daosheng contrasts such talk with conduct concerning life and death, Poshan Haiming refuses to advertise it in a letter, and Feiyin Tongrong places even its claimant back under the furnace tools.
